items.title: Review command examples against actual CLI behavior
items.context: Verify the document does not recommend non-working Codex wrapper commands and accurately describes supported Codex adapter diagnostics and verification.
items.userSees: Document review shows the execution plan recommends only real Codex adapter diagnostic/verification commands and no broken local wrapper diagnostic command.

happy.desc: CLI help confirms the local Codex wrapper command documented for adapter diagnostics resolves to codex_doctor.

edge.desc: CLI help confirms the documented local Codex wrapper verification command resolves to verify_codex.

adversarial.desc: The plan does not recommend the bare local Codex wrapper doctor command that opens general Lattice doctor instead of Codex adapter diagnostics.

verificationEvidence.note: Help output resolves to lattice codex_doctor and states Alias: lattice codex doctor, confirming the documented local wrapper diagnostic uses the Codex adapter command.
Help output resolves to lattice verify_codex and documents the optional storyId evidence argument, confirming the documented verification wrapper is valid.
The bare doctor form is described only as known residual guidance to replace; accepted guidance and verification commands use node bin/lattice-codex.js codex_doctor / verify_codex.

items.title: Review forbidden guidance scans for complete rule coverage
items.context: Ensure verification covers the full host-neutral workflow command boundary, not only session_brief and aux_doc_list.
items.userSees: Document review shows the forbidden guidance scan covers the full host-neutral workflow command boundary, not only session recovery and document discovery.

happy.desc: The forbidden guidance scan includes session_brief and aux_doc_list.

edge.desc: The forbidden guidance scan also includes story, checklist, validate, review, finding, summary, delivery, and convergence workflow families.

adversarial.desc: Repository scan only reports negative smoke-test assertions for forbidden Codex-prefixed workflow commands, not business guidance in docs or templates.

verificationEvidence.note: The forbidden namespace pattern and workflow command table explicitly include session_brief and aux_doc_list.
The forbidden namespace pattern also includes the broader workflow families: story_, checklist_, validate, review_, finding_, summary_set, delivery_check_set, and convergence_check.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n --hidden lattice\s+codex\s+session_brief AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md README.md docs packages/main/src packages/main/dist .Codex .codex; rg -n --hidden lattice\s+codex\s+aux_doc_list AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md README.md docs packages/main/src packages/main/dist .Codex .codex
verificationEvidence.note: Repository scan for the forbidden Codex-prefixed workflow forms reports only legacy-koala-compatibility-smoke negative assertions in src/dist, not business guidance in docs or templates.

Actual fail-closed rejection check exited non-zero (exit code 1). Output rejected Unsupported command: lattice codex session_brief, limited the Codex namespace to lattice codex verify/doctor, and printed the ordinary replacement: Use the ordinary command instead: lattice session_brief.

Actual fail-closed rejection check exited non-zero (exit code 1). Output rejected Unsupported command: lattice codex aux_doc_list, limited the Codex namespace to lattice codex verify/doctor, and printed the ordinary replacement: Use the ordinary command instead: lattice aux_doc_list.

items.title: Review requirements navigation synchronization
items.context: Ensure the new decision document is discoverable from docs/requirements/NAV.md and the count matches the decision file inventory.
items.userSees: Document review shows the new decision document is listed in requirements navigation and the NAV count matches the decision file inventory.

happy.desc: docs/requirements/NAV.md includes the Lattice Codex Command Boundary Execution Plan entry.

edge.desc: NAV file count equals the number of markdown files in docs/requirements/decisions.

adversarial.desc: The NAV update does not delete existing decision entries while adding the missing document entry.

verificationEvidence.note: NAV includes Lattice Codex Command Boundary Execution Plan with the correct decision document link.

verificationEvidence.command: find docs/requirements/decisions -maxdepth 1 -type f -name *.md | wc -l; rg -n ^\>\ 49\ 个文件 docs/requirements/NAV.md
verificationEvidence.note: The decisions markdown inventory is 49 files and NAV declares 49 files.
The NAV material diff updates the count and adds missing decision entries; no existing decision entry is removed.

items.title: Record review evidence and complete document delivery gates
items.context: Use scan output, CLI help output, and NAV inventory checks as verification evidence before summary and delivery review.
items.userSees: Document review is complete with recorded evidence: CLI help checks pass, scans identify only expected residual execution targets, and DONE summary states the remaining non-document cleanup boundary.

happy.desc: Validation evidence records the CLI help checks and scan commands used to review the document.

edge.desc: The delivery summary distinguishes document review completion from later template/README cleanup execution.

adversarial.desc: The story does not claim production, authority, unattended, or full convergence readiness from this document review.

verificationEvidence.note: Checklist evidence records the CLI help checks, forbidden-guidance scans, and NAV inventory checks used to review this document.
The document distinguishes this review from later README/template cleanup by naming known residual non-document targets and stating a no-overclaim boundary.
